ov: A deep-sea eel of temperate and tropical oceans, living 500–3,000 m down, with a loosely hinged mouth much larger than its body. Despite its huge jaws it has only tiny teeth and eats mostly small crustaceans. Its ultra-black skin reflects less than 0.5% of light.
len: About 0.75 m; possibly up to 1 m
rg: Temperate and tropical waters of all oceans.
df: Mainly small crustaceans such as shrimp, plus squid.
fx: The tip of its whip-like tail has a light organ that glows pink and gives off red flashes.
Many researchers believe pelican eels die shortly after breeding.
